title: Number of Vape Sellers and Buyers Caught in Recent Years
what_it_is: Number of Vape Sellers and Buyers Caught in Recent Years

sections.label: Singapore vaporiser ban and penalties
sections.summary: Singapore banned vaporisers, making sale, import, distribution, use, purchase and possession offences with fines or imprisonment, and HSA handled 219 sale cases and 465 possession cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health banned vaporisers to protect the public from health risks associated with such products.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It is an offence under the Tobacco (Control of Advertisements and Sale) Act to sell, possess for sale, import or distribute vaporisers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Any person who is convicted is liable to a fine not exceeding $10,000 or to imprisonment of up to six months or to both for the first offence, and to a fine not exceeding $20,000 or to imprisonment of up to 12 months or to both, for the second or subsequent offence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: With effect from 1 February 2018, the use, purchase or possession of vaporisers is also an offence and is punishable with a fine of up to $2,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: From 1 January 2017 to 30 September 2019, the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) handled 219 cases involving the sale of vaporisers, all of which were sold online.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: From 1 February 2018 to 30 September 2019, 465 people were caught for the possession of vaporisers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The stiffest penalty imposed was $99,000, for a peddler who was charged on 9 September 2019 for importing and peddling e-cigarettes.

sections.label: E-cigarette counselling quit rate
sections.summary: With counselling, 18% of smokers in the e-cigarette group quit smoking at 12 months post-intervention.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: When combined with counselling, 18% of smokers in the e-cigarette group quit smoking at 12 months post-intervention.
